newsitem.title: USA: CBOT Dec wheat jumps on delivery stopper, covering.
newsitem.headline: CBOT Dec wheat jumps on delivery stopper, covering.

text.p: CBOT December wheat was strongly higher early on strong stopping of the deliveries posted against that month, traders said.
Short covering before expiration of the December contributed to the advances and the volume was very thin ahead of the contract expiration at 1201 CST/1801 GMT Thursday.
"Whoever was short in there got very nervous because Dreyfus stopped all the wheat," a trader said.
Term Commodities, the marketing arm for Louis Dreyfus Corp, stopped 715,000 bushels of 815,000 posted Thursday for delivery on the December, according to the CBOT.
At 0948 CST, wheat was three to nine cents per bushel higher, with December up nine at $4.11. March was up 4-3/4 at $4.05-1/2.
